name: agent-team-workflow
description: Run a persistent three-role agent development team with architecture leadership, bounded implementation, independent review, and recoverable handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Lead, implement, review, and recover an agent team.
interface.longDescription: Provides a persistent team workflow with a user-facing architecture Leader, a visible Executor Mother using bounded internal subagents, an independent Reviewer, durable project state, and recoverable Leader succession. Codex with CC-Panes is the first reference adapter.
defaultPrompt: Lead this project through architecture, implementation, and independent review.
Execute the approved project spec with safely bounded internal subagents.
Independently review the current coordinated implementation.
